text: really solid build, lots of attention to detail. i only knock off one mark because there's no paper user manual.

the m135 xdrive is a joy to drive, powerful and feels safe. it is a very good looking car and extremely comfortable inside. i've had lots of different cars over the years but this one is definitely the best.

i've always been a big fan of the brand, starting with my first bmw, a used e46 320i coupe back in 2007, then an e83 x3 2.5i, before working in the bmw retailer network as a parts manager and later an aftersales manager, driving lots of company cars over the years, my favourite being the g21 m340d. after getting my wife an f56 cooper sport as her first car a couple of years ago, when it was time to change, the new 1 series was the obvious choice. she absolutely loves it and now understands why i've always said bmw will always be the best brand. james and the team at northbridge bmw chester were fantastic and turned her first new bmw handover into an experience she'll remember.

offers a great balance of comfort and sport, ideal for anyone wanting that mix.
i do feel the assist motor power could be just a bit stronger!

i was driving a golf 7.5 before and felt it was more stable and better to operate than local cars, but the 120 takes stability even further. i can tell that its rigidity and its quietness are key parts of those fundamentals.

very good to drive and the extra driver safety tech is very useful. the only frustration is not being able to turn off auto stop start for good, i have to cancel it on every start. please advise if there is a way to set this permanently. thanks

nice little car but it did take me a fair while to get my head around all the tech, i prefer things very plain and simple and as an older driver it felt a bit of a slog at the start. i specced the car with almost every extra i could get, as thats what i tend to do. now i am really pleased with it, the way it clings to the road is like a limpet and the steering gives loads of feedback, it almost feels like the car is talking to me and i always feel totally in control. over the years ive had around seven bmws, mostly three series and a couple of x2, and this one is every bit as good as those.

its a really good car, definitely feels like an upgrade over my old f40 118i m sport. engine is strong and the mild hybrid gives a nice extra shove and helps with efficiency. it corners and rides very well and im getting better fuel economy than with the f40. some of the cabin materials feel a bit flimsier than before, not a big deal but i did notice. the new cabin layout looks great and all the digital stuff behaves properly. a few oddities though: the keyless entry/exit reacts way too easily, and sometimes the car systems seem to randomly reset, so auto hold ends up switched off in the menu even though i had it on. the speed warning feature is just irritating, even if i can switch it off each trip here in the uk.

fuel efficient and economical
quiet on the move and simple to drive.
its a design i dont get tired of
would prefer a dial for operating the screen
also think its better to have a muffler

the car drives nicely, is comfy, engine feels strong and the steering is quite light, but getting used to all the touchscreen tech is a nightmare. the previous idrive setup was almost perfect and should have been left alone. for example, getting the preset radio stations back onto the display is almost impossible, and being forced to use a touchscreen while driving is a dangerous distraction. there is no proper written owners manual, just loads of videos, which is disappointing as even a simple booklet would have helped. not being able to choose run flat tyres is a step backwards, and with no spare tyre that could be dangerous.

i'm really pleased with the upgrades on my new 1 series. the suspension and handling feel more refined. the small changes in the software and how the digital system works make it simpler to carry out the basic things.
the build quality seems not great; my seat has squeaks that i only noticed after turning my music off due to a damaged speaker. very frustrating to deal with both issues.
compact and very nimble car.

the harman kardon is really very poor, and there is too much tech with too few proper buttons and knobs for key functions. the vent controls are awkward to operate. i was so disappointed with this car that i ended up selling it after only 2 months, taking a big financial loss.

overall the car is very good, drives nicely, feels comfortable and looks smart. however, using the touch screen for various controls is awkward and far too complicated. the car actually broke down in the first two weeks of ownership and then needed nearly three weeks to be repaired, which is very disappointing for a new vehicle and below what i'd expect from bmw.

driving feel that makes you forget its front wheel drive.
comes fully loaded with on-board gear.
you travel nicely, with safety and a luxurios feel.

looks superb, great driveability and performance, good economy, and the interior comfort with the m front seats. the options i picked when buying plus the driver aids all help, i really enjoy driving this car.

i'm mostly pleased with the car except for the satellite navigation. when we use it, it has taken us down tiny lanes that are only just wide enough for one vehicle so you can't get past anything coming the other way. this has happened on three trips and led to hold-ups and a lot of stress. my last 1 series let me pick between the fastest route and the shortest one but this new model doesn't offer that choice. i checked with the dealer and they confirmed this. i've chatted to other bmw drivers and they no longer rely on the idrive navigation, they just use their phones. i went for bmw as a premium brand but i'm really unhappy that the sat nav is basically not fit for purpose. simon fairclough [EMAIL]
the mileage is good and the interior is also good.
smoothness and satisfaction
the car is fantastic to drive. it's my first automatic and it's incredibly easy to use. i'm very happy with it.

the car drives very well and has some lovely features, however i've had problems with both display modules going totally blank several times, always when the outside temperature is under zero degrees. the vehicle is currently with the local dealer for checks and repair.

this is my 4th bmw 1 series and easily the best to drive. the mild hybrid setup is excellent, same with the automatic gearbox. i have already done around a 1000 mile round trip to france in great comfort and with superb fuel economy.

really nice to drive, feels secure with loads of grip on the road. seats are comfy and supportive, shame there isnt any lumbar support. infotainment is decent but ive hit a few issues. tivo keeps saying no connection and asking to retry, started happening after my annual subscription kicked in.
front seats dont give the support they should. brakes feel very unprogressive, either doing nothing or suddenly really sharp.

the car drives well and is comfortable with plenty of space. i'm still getting my head around the technical features, mainly because i haven't been in the car much thanks to a health issue. i do like the stylish appearance of the car.
i absolutely love this car, it rides so smoothly and is really comfortable. the performance is terrific all round. it was always my dream car and still is, and it does not let me down in any part.

easy car to drive and it gives a real sense of peace of mind.

improvements
the door pocket is slightly awkward to use, it is so deep things end up out of easy reach.

there are far too many technical features added which feel unnecessary and possibly dangerous. it seems to have lost its way that it is meant to be a car. standard useful and necessary items have been taken away or need to be reset every time you start a journey.
lots of power packed into a small body
the compact size, strong performance, and the more sophisticated overall form.
very good car with excellent driving performance, but i'm disappointed there's no split or individual front seat aircon and no central control for the rear seats like my old 1 series had.
i do really like the car, but i think some connected drive features like spotify and the better maps should be included as standard rather than extra.

this 1 series is my first ever bmw and i'm really impressed with the power, the fuel economy and how comfortable it is. the amount of standard kit is great, and the safety features make me feel confident and are a big help, especially when parking. the seats are extremely comfortable and the cabin is very quiet, so it is a very enjoyable car to drive. the materials used inside feel high quality and the os9 instruments are very detailed with lots of different display options. i would happily recommend the 1 series and i expect to stay with bmw for many years.
ideal-sized car for town driving with a really cracking engine
its compact but comfy to ride in and really easy to drive

i used to own an m135i, and that one was much more fun to drive, mainly because the exhaust sounded fantastic. the new m135 has almost no sound and feels boring to drive, even though the new interior is really well done.

i have been running bmw cars for close to 50 years, both new and used, for personal use and for work. before choosing the 120 i looked very closely at almost every rival in the same price bracket and simply couldnt find a reason not to go for the 120. the spec, the quality and the service are just better than the rest.
the driving feel is good, but the software is terrible, the car acts like it has its own mind and starts doing things for no clear reason. very inconsistent behavior. i absolutely hate it!!

i'm very pleased with the car, though it could feel a little more engaging, but given my last car was a v8 m3 that's probably not a fair benchmark. i am however totally disappointed with the insurance setup, as the 5 day pick up insurance was never activated by the dealer, and even after raising it with you there's been no satisfactory reply. at this point i feel going to the regulator might be the only route.

there is a weird droning sound coming from the rear on the drivers side, and it has been there since i picked it up from the showroom. the demo car i tried before, same model, did not have that noise. the dealer is still trying to find another demo car so they can see if this is normal for the model or just my particular vehicle.
great car, good looks, handles nicely

this is my fourth brand new bmw. this version is quite a departure from my old 118i m sport and has lost a number of refinements that used to come as standard, which is a let-down. even so, i'd still score it 10 because of the solid bmw enginering.
the best car i have ever driven

the mild hybrid start feels subtle.
there are too many separate safety systems.
frequent stops when refueling. etc

service has been fine and the car itself is good. the only issue is the creasing on the front alcantara seats, both driver and passenger, they really dont look up to the level of the seats in my earlier bmw cars. i am already in touch with the dealer about this problem and hoping that, if it turns out to be a design fault, it will get sorted out.
very good-looking car, modern interior with features that fit that modern style.
suspension feels overly firm, lots of passengers mention it.
the ride is supposed to be comfortable, and it mostly is. however, i felt the sunlight ought to be reduced a bit more.
great fuel economy with really comfortable ride quality

good-looking car, comfortable with strong performance and decent equipment.
very happy with it - simple to drive, comfy and with good functionality.
i'm happy with all aspects of it, but the cost keeps me from telling everyone to get one

this car fits my daily needs perfectly.great fun to drive, very comfortable, stylish and looks amazing, it gets plenty of remarks all of them good & on top of that the hybrid setup is even better than i imagined. this is my 8th bmw & while i was very pleased with the other seven this one really goes further. fuel economy is also even better than i wished for.
it drives well, with excellent acceleration!!
solidly built car with up-to-date technology. as a pensioner i would have preferred to have a hard copy user manual.
car itself is really excellent, just let down by the new tech system being way too complicated.
great driving performance, nice styling and good fuel economy.

I had a 118i m sport before and the 120 m sport has had all the useful bits stripped out and is not a sport model at all! this is our 6th bmw and easily the worst car we've ever had. 1. no 12v socket in the boot, a ridiculous penny pinching move. 2. no phone charging points in the back. 3. no climate controls in the rear. 4. no fog lights. 5. no leather seats. 6. no visible exhaust, sport model?? 7. basic 18" alloys (19" were standard on the 118i), sport model?? 8. thin, cheap carpets with poor grip and no m sport trim. every one of these came standard on the 118i m sport and the 120 m sport is marketed as its direct replacement! the 120 m sport is about £7/8k more, plus paying again for all the things removed, making it a pricey car and the worst thing ever to come out of a bmw showroom. total rubbish!
even with the easy handling, you still really feel the fun that comes from riding a bmw.
really nice car to drive and it looks great as well. first time i have had an automatic and i am enjoying that a lot.

the size and the way it handles feel spot on, and its running performance is the best. it fits 5 people, and i think it is the best option as long as you are ok with the firm ride and not taking big luggage.
i want a sports car that not many people are in. the m135 has excellent performance, but it does not feel ahead of other cars.

the car went back to the dealer on 12th october 2024 for inspection because one headlamp had constant moisture inside. we were told a replacement would take about 2 weeks to arrive. we are still waiting for our car to come back. weve only been able to enjoy this brand new bmw, one of the first f70 1 series in the uk, for 6 weeks out of 17 weeks of owning it! this is really upsetting and not acceptable. bmw uk are aware of what is going on but we still have no date for when we will get the car back.
great motorcar, stylish with a quality drvie

over roughly the last 15 years ive had a new 1 series each time, and every version has got better. the 123 is the best yet, x drive has definitely improved the road holding and the petrol consumption is excellent. i feel the air conditioning controls should be manual, same for the sat nav. the wheel design needs changing as theyre a real nuisance to clean, just like the front grill. apart from that its a first class car and im already looking forward to my next bmw in around 2.5 years.
it feels small and easy to handle, and it comes nicely equiped, but the suspension is way too hard.

after my husband changed his phone he has not been able to load the bmw app, and even though he has asked for help he just keeps getting passed around. on the day we collected the car it was not ready because they had sprayed the roof black as they could not secure the car we had been promised. we did not get a proper hand over as we were anxious about picking up primary schoolchildren and had told the garage we would have to go. about 5 or 6 weeks later we needed an emergency technician and the car had to return to the garage because the gps in the roof fin had been damaged by rain, so the roof was resprayed. now in feb we still do not have the car we originally ordered and are waiting for a part for the black grill it should have had. the new manager martin has been trying to sort things out. we had other problems too but i am running out of spa.

i find the constant speed alert annoying, having to switch it off every single time i get in. at night the dash doesnt light up the vent position controls, and the lights at the end of the dash reflect in the side windows, getting in the way of the view in the door mirrors. the car really ought to have electric tailgate controls as standard.
very good value to run, since it can use the cheapest diesel while petrol prices keep rising. the strong acceleration makes it really fun to drive.

i really like the car overall, but having only a full touch screen with no physical buttons is irritating and quite distracting. after just a few months the touch screen already feels slow. the buttons on the previous model were far better and much easier to operate.
i really enjoy driving this new car, the pickup is faster and there is none of the lag the last model had. the boost button has been very handy when joining the a12 with its short run in.
i cant play music from a usb flash drive, and android auto is awkward to use.
really like this car, it rides comfortably, has good fuel economy and is fun to drive. plenty of space with decent leg room in the back seats.
because the auto drive worked well

we run two cars at the moment, the new bmw and a 6 year old mini countryman 2 litre petrol. i actually like the countryman much more, so much so that if i could have bought a new like for like countryman i would have gone for that instead of the bmw. it is far more comfortable, nicer to drive and easily quick enough, with not a huge gap in mpg between them. the dials and controls are more old school on the countryman but i find them simpler to use and they give everything a driver needs. ideally i would keep my 6 year old mini and also have a brand new one with the same specification rather than the bmw. despite that i am still generally a fan of bmw. happy to talk about it further.  mark benson.

the fundamental performance of the car is spot on. the people at the dealership are excellent, both on the sales side and in service. the downside is that older people have a hard time figuring out how the different applications and functions work. after an update, the settings i had made, like the automatic parking brake feature and my mobile phone registration, were all reset.

i changed from the 3 series because of the parking space, but even though this is smaller and narrower it doesn't feel tight inside, and it is quick on its feet and has enough power. i really liked the instrument panel design, it looks upscale and is easy to read. i chose the m sport and i'm also pleased with the suspension and the audio. i think it is recommendable for people who want good fuel economy and do not like driving something big.

i have had this one for about three months now, but i still don't really remember the feeling of sliding in the same model as before. what stands out is how simple it is to control and how it can cruise calmly even when i'm going fast. the price of the car itself feels quite high though. i picked this model because i was willing to pay more in order to get a comfortable drive. originally i chose a 116i f20 for my wife, and the steering on that is outstanding, you can really sense what the driver is feeling. after that, i bought a lexus is as a replacement for a 435i and that was excellent too. then came the 116i m135, which is also strong in power and easy to manage, and now i'm on an x3m competition. i use the m135 around town and the x3mc when i'm going at high speeds.
it's a lovely car, but i'm really annoyed that the latest system update stopped auto hold from staying on, so now i have to switch it back on every single trip.
it drives nicely and stays quiet. it comes with full equipment. the controls are simple to handle. fuel efficiency is very good. i enjoy being behind the wheel. i also appreciate the design.
simple to handle around city streets

・while driving, the interior light randomly comes on and can only be switched off via the screen.

this car has been a total let down. if i could get my old 2021 m135i back i would be far happier. the apps and drive modes are overly complex, not user friendly at all, and far too distracting and difficult to use while driving, so you basically have to stop to deal with them. the way it handles is like a boat in a storm, no matter which drive setting you choose, and it is definitely not a sport hatch. the driving sound is too fake, the interior feels cheap, and a lot of practical conveniences have disappeared. there is no storage box on the driver side of the dash and no 12v socket in the boot. the m sport seats now lack support and comfort, unlike the previous standard version of those seats. after 3 months in this i am already looking to swap to another car. it is the worst car change i have made, not an improvement at all, and a big regrettable mistake.

we have owned bmws for many years, so we are disappointed with our latest 120i m sport, first registered april 2025. we added extra optional kit on top of the standard packages. we have made numerous calls to the dealership about the exterior door handle lighting that is fitted, as we cannot get it programmed and the dealer says they cannot assist. we have found a matching 2025 car without the comfort package where the handles have no lights at all, which makes me think our lights were never coded from new. we have also seen, in certain sunlight, tiny speckles across the front windscreen. we asked about this and were told the dealer needs to view it, but for reasons beyond our control we have not managed to go. we will look forward to your reply.
i like my new car, but i would much rather have a paper manual. having it in an app on my phone or ipad or on the car screen is ok, yet its just easier to check an index and a page number in a book.
because the fuel consumption turned out worse than i expecetd.

for the money, the bmw 120 feels like an incredible amount of car, with comfort and driving enjoyment you usually link to much bigger models. i am hugely impressed and really very pleased with the choice i made!

being able to do tight turns is convenient.
its compact size is fine even in the long run
gas mileage is good.
really enjoyable to drive, performance is excellent, exactly what you expect from bmw
very good fuel economy

brakes have awful progression when trying to creep forward in a car park, they feel jerky and not smooth like any other auto i have owned, which is very annoying. the passenger seatbelt keeps knocking when it is not being used. i also think it is ridiculous that extra features cost more, shame on you bmw. on the positive side it does drive better than my last car.

when i bought the car they said it came with a paper manual, and i even had to sign a form saying the manual was with the vehicle, but there was none when it was delivered. i reported this straight away and was told one would be posted. nothing turned up. went past the showroom about a month later, went in, and was again told a manual would be sent. waited another month, still nothing, so i emailed the salesman who once more promised it would be sent, and again nothing. just tell me if you have stopped supplying hard copy manuals, dont keep putting me off hoping i wont remember.
i really like this car and would easily recommend it, it is a pleasure to drive. only thing is i want proper heating a/c buttons instead of all on the screen, and a dial for the screen too.
really enjoy driving it, such a beautiful looking car, feels solid on the road and handles nicely. there are features that help a lot when driving and parking, i honestly feel lucky to own it.
really excellent overall package, drives well in both normal and sport settings.
i moved from a 3 series to a 1 series, and the steering wheel feels light, easy to handle, needing only small turns.
the size of the car feels just right, quick but still economical. i also really like having xdrive and i'm already planning to put on winter wheels.
pickup and mileage

really enjoyable car to drive.

superior driving performance compared with the 118d

the suspension suits me perfectly.
there is ample power, so driving never feels stressful.
the car is not large in size, and that makes it easy to live with.

after years of driving fairly bland everyday cars, this one has been a real breath of fresh air in terms of driving dynamics. the last car i enjoyed as much was an audi ur quattro i bought back in 1987 and kept for about 12 years. i plan to hang on to this one for a while too, though i might look at a 123 xdrive at some point, even though this car certainly isn't short on performance. i've already suggested it to a friend, although he ended up with a 220 instead. we were both unhappy that bmw deleted the m badges from the front wings on the m sport versions, so we bought the badges ourselves. it really feels like a cost-cutting move, and i hope bmw changes that decision. overall i'm very satisfied and would recommend it to anyone.

really wonderfull car, with this modern full screen setup that shows pretty much all the info you could want. when i compare it to my old 69 plate bmw 1, this new version is miles better, it stands out totally and is just fantastic to me.
high performance car and a smart step up from my previous model. reasonably economical too, averaging about 35mpg for me, with a comfortable and responsive drive.
the car is really straightforward to drive, but the suspension feels quite harsh on rough roads, and there are plenty of those around surrey.

far too much reliance on the bmnw app, and you can't really use the sat nav properly unless you register with the app.

the ride itself is comfortable, but with everything run by the computer, it is hard for a non-digital person to figure out. recently the driver side door locked and would not open from inside, so i had to get out through the passenger side. the dealership also does not know why it happened. it has only occurred once, but it leaves me uneasy.
