its the little detail things that really stand out tyre valve caps the same colour as the body 3 front screen washers so you always have clear vision the rear seatbelt anchors split apart and the overall build qulity is excellent.
easy to ride, good comfort and nice design.
excellent to drive, really strong driver experience.

i find the 7 speed dct gets slightly jerky at low speeds and when the car is cold. the climate controls on the display are annoying, my daughters older 1 series with real buttons was better. the passenger belt taps on the hard plastic when it is not being worn.
really like the larger wheels and tyres, they make the ride much nicer on our third world roads.
small footprint, simple to drive
very good to drive and easy to handle, also very economical on petrol with a very good allround view.
steering wheel feels too thick for female hands, especially over a long trip.

it's a good car, but the way the map magnification is controlled on-screen is extremely dangerous and very distracting, and could easily cause accidents just like using mobile phones. the old setup with a central control knob meant the driver could alter map zoom without taking attention off the road, whereas this new finger-on-screen method does exactly the opposite. i do have a simple workaround that would only need software changes, not a full redesign of the car: the knurled volume wheel could be used for both volume and map zoom, switching between them with a double click on the wheel. i cannot emphasise enough how strongly i feel about this; with this stupid system it is only a matter of time before someone gets killed.

overall it is a very good car. however, the automatic gear control does not feel as good or as natural as on the previous version, which was better with a lever you could actually grip instead of this switch-style setup. the steering also feels lighter, and because of that the car does not feel as stable on the road.
really happy with the car and the colour, but not impressed there isn't any handbook and also annoyed that premium digital costs extra.

i really like my car and have been a bmw fan since my first one a few years back. however there are little things that drag the score down, like the handbrake not engaging automatically when i put it in neutral, and having to pay extra for adaptive cruise control. there is also a buzzing coming from the driver door at highway speeds, which feels like something you would find on a cheaper car, not a bmw.

was unsure about switching from a performance 2.3 to the 1.5, but i'm completely pleased with the 120 now - it feels like a quality car, drives really well, the fuel economy is superb and i honestly can't find a downside.

to be fair i wasn't first looking at this particular model, but i have to say i'm really happy with the overall quality. my only gripe is the need for a subscription to keep the car current and the fact there are very few offers once you've taken on a £50000 plus car. a friend picked up a used x3 for less money and has been given reduced price subscriptions.

well equipped and pleasant to drive. i am unhappy with some elements of the setup, for example how the locking works when there are two drivers in the car. very let down by extras like mud flaps. information from the dealer and bmw uk frequently does not match.
fantastic car, econmical and reliable, great to drive and i really like the safety features and tech.
i love this car, it drives really smoothly and the colour is fantastic.

if this is the new 120m then the purchase has been an unmitigated disaster. far too complicated, seats uncomfortable, no solid feel. luckily our previous car had not yet been resold so we were able to buy it back. the local dealer did the best deal they could but we still took a considerable loss. this new range is the worst we have experienced. not bmw's finest hour. ([EMAIL])

the inside looks great and the outside is just as impressive. power, safety, everyday convenience and the whole user interface setup are all spot on. as a compact car it feels almost perfectly put together.
i would still recommend it thanks to the price, compact size, quality and looks. but the fuel economy turned out worse than expected, so it is 9 points, minus 1 point for that.

the car drives nicely but sadly it does not meet our needs. the boot is smaller than we thought, and with the hybrid battery taking up space, which we did not realise, it is no use for trips with our dog. once the driving position is set, it has to be moved again so the smaller driver can get out of the vehicle. having almost everything run through the display screen instead of the steering wheel controls is distracting when driving and does not feel like a safe setup. apple car play is unreliable and seems to need tinkering every single time you use the car. there is no separate air conditioning for driver and passenger.

i am really happy with how it rides, how easy it is to handle, and the feeling of speed. the cockpit features are straightforward to operate and look refined, which is very pleasing. the driver assistance systems feel on par with the 3 series and higher, so long trips are enjoyable, you can drive safely and not feel worn out. overall it comes across as a very good car with excellent cost performance.

the overall body size turned out larger than i had imagined, though the inside feels roomy, and the acceleration is good for the engine size. it is packed with lots of detailed functions, but the price came in higher than i expected, the door feels heavy, and the driver window is set high so it is hard to lean in when putting the car into the garage. i cannot switch off the front light, and i would like the air conditioner to blow only from my feet, but that option is not available. the trunk area is small, so i cannot carry as much luggage as i thought. the vibration while driving is quite strong, so it cannot really be called comfortable.
excellent. the ride over rough english roads is far better than the m sport.

steering and handling are excellent. interior feels upmarket and the seats are very comfortable. economy is very strong yet performance is still good. there is, however, a notable delay on the throttle. the satnav is not as clear or informative as the one in the x2. the speedometer and rev counter are almost useless, hard to read because of the colours and graduated markings, even though the digital speed readout itself is easy to see. far too many settings overall and the menus are awkward to find your way through.
among the best cars i have ever driven - genuinely thrilled with it.

the car is enjoyable to drive and uses less petrol than i expected. on the downside it is overcomplicated, with far too much reliance on the display screen where proper physical buttons would be safer and more practical. there are two temperature sliders that stay permanently synced, which makes one of them pointless and irritating. there is also a software issue where the recommended tyre pressures keep changing, apparently because the tyre information is not stored correctly. the car was delivered without an owner's handbook; after getting one later, i find it very poor, with no clear way to see which parts apply to my specific car. it wastes space on general 'principle' sections instead of clearly explaining how features operate and how to control them. finally, the door mirrors stick out too far and add unnecessary width, they could definitely be smaller.

idrive 9 is awful. feels bloated, with loads of stuff nobody needs. trying to use it while actually driving feels unsafe. i really don't want to have a conversation with the car just to adjust the fan. the home screen can't be changed to anything useful. if this system stays like this, i won't buy another bmw. the car itself is very good, but id9 completely kills the fun of driving it.
for this price i expected front fog lights, and i also thought bmw connect drive would stay active more than 6 months.

this new car is easier to drive than my old manual one. i used to struggle stretching my legs to reach the pedals, so not needing my left leg now really helps. it has lots of features that weren't on my last car, some of them are clever and useful. the orange triangle lights on the wing mirrors are very helpful and weren't there before. i also like the speed warning alerts. overall it's an upgrade from my previous car, i do like it and would recommend it to family and friends.

i'm really happy with the car, the way it drives is amazing and it feels like bmw quality at its finest. i wouldve rated it a 10, but the connect drive service in the car stopped after about 3 months from buying it. i had no idea it would end so soon and i expected that kind of feature to stay active free for at least the first year on a brand new car. i've gone ahead and renewed connect drive now, but that means another cost that wasnt factored in when i bought it, and with how things are money-wise at the moment every extra expense counts.

i have already had to return the car multiple times because it suddenly stopped working in the middle of the highway and nothing was identified as wrong. i also brought it back because the seat belts were not functioning. this has all happened within just two months of owning the car.
better than the old version, nicer ride overall and the inside feels more mature.
very pleased with the car and how it performs. the fuel economy has turned out better than i expected.

even though it is a compact car that is easy to control, the cabin and seats feel very high quality and the ride stays comfortable. switching to sports mode makes the engine and steering feel sharpen up, giving it a totally different, more tense character.

the car itself is ok but the infotainment ruins the driving feel i was hoping for. you have dropped the basics in favour of stuff that does not matter like light colours and other trivia. before every drive i spend about 5 minutes setting everything how i want, and it still goes back to the default as soon as i stop. the endless stream of messages is distracting, same with the pings and bongs whenever the car does not like what i do. for a while i really thought i had a puncture until i found out it was the car shaking through the steering wheel. there is no need for most of this info and i think some of it is distracting and maybe even lethal. i want to watch the road, not the screen. and useful things like the petrol gauge are tiny and almost hidden on the display. out of space
even with a 3-cylinder 1500 engine, the acceleration and cruising speed are on a different level compared to domestic cars.

i picked up the car on the 24th of august. it was meant to be ready on the 23rd and i had taken annual leave, but there was an error message on the car that they could not sort so i only collected it a day later. then on the 21st of september, as i was leaving my work address, i got a drivetrain brake fault and the car refused to let me drive. i rang bmw support at 7pm and was told nobody could come out until the following day, so i phoned rbc instead and they came the next day, saying there were several errors and to call bmw in the morning. bmw turned up the next morning, by then the hazards had been left on all night so it had switched to the second battery, which did a restart. now, fast forward to today, i have no parking brake at all and i am just about to call again.
strong performance and handling, but the interior feels low quality.

my car broke down and i couldnt get it started again, after roughly two months and about 3000kms on the clock. quite penalizing for someone investing in a new car for safety, expecting no nasty surprises!

the driving performance is nearly good, but the ride comfort has a bit of a downside (the car reacts too sharply to bumps and uneven road surfaces, and the vibration comes straight through. i feel it has become worse compared with the 3 series and 5 series, and i would like that to be improved. ).
the safe driving functions are upgraded and very good. the connection to my mobile phone works well and it is handy to check the vehicle status when doing a recording or when the car is parked beforehand, but when i drive for about half a day the driving record does not transfer to the phone, which makes it awkward to check mileage and fuel economy. i talked to the dealer service and did a re-registration, but the data for that day still did not show up.

excellent engine. ive been in bmws for about 17 years and theyve never let me down. comfy, good quality interior, paintwork is excellent and the computer is easy to figure out. wouldnt choose any other car.
i wish it had more natural sound instead of the fake internal sound. handlng and ride of the car are really good and the seats are excellent.
i am really pleased with my new bmw, it is very nice to drive and the parking sensors are an absolute godsend.

good car to drive, it handles well and is quick enough for what i need. interior is nice, but the touchscreen setup is frankly unsafe to use on the move and really needs an idrive wheel to be safer. i don't see why that was removed other than to cut costs. turning off the speed limit and the equally risky lane departure warning is too fiddly, there should be a button for each. the my modes feature in this 120 is almost useless, adding no real driving benefit, just extra complexity and probably cost. the boot is too small for a car of this size. even with these complaints, it still suits my needs perfectly right now, and despite the over-complex tech the interface is still far better than my wife's mercedes a class.

i've been driving an m135 for around five years now. the one i got in april is spot on - smooth, properly punchy in sport mode, very comfortable and the tech support is excellent. but back in february i took delivery of a new m135 that lasted only about four days before it failed completely and came to a total stop. nobody ever came up with a diagnosis.

i had to bring in a solicitor to get that unreliable car returned and to secure a like-for-like replacement. after weeks of hassle, worry and extra expense, i did not receive a single word of apology from bmw. that is not the kind of response i would expect when paying over 42000 pounds for a car. while i'm really pleased with the m135 i have now, i'm still very disappointed with bmw and am waiting for your apolgy.

because of its shape and compact size it fits easily into parking spaces. i enjoy the sound when it accelerates. performance is of course good, and in the bends it feels stable and goes exactly how i want it to.
the strong torque and the suspension both add to how much you enjoy driving it. the seats also help make the ride more confortable.

i would really have liked the option of a manual gearbox, and that would have pushed my rating higher, but as with many brands it seems bmw no longer offers this to buyers. overall the car is great fun to drive when you are not manoeuvring. a few small niggles: still no intermittent setting for the windscreen wipers when they are not in auto mode; the driver seatbelt cannot be adjusted for height so i am always fiddling with it while driving; the driver seat could go lower to give extra headroom when getting in; software updates wipe out settings, especially autohold being turned on. before purchase i would have appreciated a brochure clearly listing the equipment on each model so i could compare, and when reading the handbook, to know whether my car is supposed to have a given feature. also, comfort access does not include foot boot opening even though it was shown in the app before delivery.

i'm happy with how the car looks, though i'm not really a fan of the red callipers. it seems pretty good on fuel. the sat nav isn't great as it won't take voice commands, most times when i ask for directions it just says it can't help, which is frustrating when you want to set a route on the move. the cabin is comfortable and the boot has plenty of space.
before, i figured volkswagen was the top choice in this segment, but this ff car feels almost like a 4wd, so i can drive it with real confidence.
first class interior, equipment and power.

for me at 70, the safety and driving systems in the car are excellent. they let you drive feeling relaxed and give both physical and mental comfort. the fuel economy was better than i expected as well, at 23.6 km/l over roughly 500 km of high speed driving.
you can really enjoy the pleasure of driving it.
being compact it's simple to wash, and overall it's just the right car for my current car life.
meets all my needs - tech, performance, kerb appeal and decent economy.
the fuel economy turned out better than i expected.
the car drives excellently and is very economical on fuel.
because i am happy with the run, the equipment, the performance and the exterior

the car itself is good, looks nice and drives well. the parking mirror doesn't work and has never worked - i've been in touch with the dealership over and over but sadly had no response. econmy is good as well.
the boot space is pretty small, and after roughly 3 months it had to go back for a recall because of an issue with the rear seatbelts.
it offers strong performance yet stays comfortable to drive.
exceptional drive and the steering feels very responsive. the boost the 48 battery gives is fantastic whenever it's needed, and the bmw build quality shows all through the car.
because i am really satisfied with both the comfort of the ride and the functions.
the car is not huge, but the engine is really powerful. the seats are amazingly comfortable and it even has massage seats, i honestly couldn't be happier
it feels very secure and stable to drive, so it is really comfortable in terms of safety and handling. especially, i use the autonomous driving feature with a lot of confidence.

i picked the bmw 120 m sport because in this segment it seemed the best overall mix of equipment and value for money. it looks sharp, feels very refined and is straightforward to drive, with a solid quality feel. performance is strong, and both fuel economy and emissions are impressive. the interior finish is high quality, the seats are very comfortable, and the infotainment is wide ranging yet simple to use. features like parking assist and the other safety tech are handy and easy to set up. so far the car has been very easy to live with, with no faults or reliability issues.
wish it came with front fog lights and leather seats as standard equipment.
fantastic car with plenty of gadgets, drives smoothly and looks very smart, absolutely love it.
very smooth ride

the car itself is amazing, but i find it a real issue that lots of basic functions (like the stop start function) are only reachable through the screen, which is very distracting when you're actualy driving.
because the safety systems and the driving assistance functions are current and up to date.

pros: happy with the basic performance.
cons: the it systems are awkward to use and the fuel economy is bad.
overall, just those points.
good looking car, simple to handle and uses less fuel than i thought

i do love the car itself, but i assumed the spec was the same as my last bmw. only after buying and driving off did i realise there's no way to play my audiobooks, no rear charging points for grandchildren or other passengers, and no rear heater blower. very disappointed.
compared with the 420, the ride quality feels completely different, and it is easy to ride.

it is a small car with a decent bit of power. my last car was also a 118d. this one has a mild hybrid system and i am completely satisfied with that.
　the tyres are not good, and they are made in china.

overall it is a good car but i do have issues: drivetrain - it behaves more like a plain fwd than a rear-biased 4wd and you can feel torque steer. dashboard controls - getting rid of the physical buttons and burying everything in the touchscreen is awkward and could even be unsafe. the ui has become a nuisance: to switch into sport mode i have to go through several steps, and since the voice control is flaky and i don't want to chat to my car, that's not an option. when using nav i have to 1) hit the mode button on the centre console, 2) pick the mode on the display, then 3) tap nav on the side of the screen to get the map back. build quality - the plastics feel low grade and there are rattles, particularly around the dash. steering wheel - this is meant to be a sporty hatch, so please stop fitting wheels sized like they belong on a boat.

wonderful to drive and really beautiful to look at, for me the best car available in this price bracket. it feels reliable and solid and i feel safe in it. inside it has everything i need and the customer service has been great. my husband has had several bmws over the years, including 5 series, x5s and an m4, and every one of them has been excellent.

i'm happy with the car itself, but some of the sensors feel actually dangerous. when i get too near the car in front, it suddenly sets off an alarm that really scares me and i worry it could cause an accident. the parking sensors also seem to beep at the wrong times, which makes me very nervous and anxious because the alerts are so intense. plus the tyre pressure gauge keeps changing all the time so i never really know how much air i'm supposed to put in.
it's a really solid car, drives nicely and feels comfortable
driving feel, stability and power

i was never told that the new car came with bmw premium digital. after about 3 months i suddenly get an email saying the service is ending. then i am basically forced to sign up for a bunch of services and apps that i thought were part of the purchase. it makes no difference if you call this connected drive or something else, it is not serious behaviour from bmw and i do not want any involvement with your digital services at all. on my previous car they did not work very well either. very bad behaviour from the dealer, only meant to trick customers out of money.
i absolutely love evrything about this car, it feels like a huge step up from the previous version. the driving position is less

performance, comfort and sound system are good. the displays, especially the touchscreen for basic functions, really let the car down. even once you know where things like the heating controls sit on the screen, the time spent glancing away from the windscreen and trying to hit the exact spot takes attention away from actually driving and focusing on the road!   this is my fourth 1 series bmw (first m) and although it is still early days, i will not be rushing to buy another.
the technology pack realy helps out, it assists and makes both parking and reversing much safer and easier.
very nice to drive with excellent features and really good fuel efficiency.
very fuel-efficient and really simple to drive.
the size feels about right, it handles nicely and it drives well overall.

1. the cabin lights reflect off the door mirror so badly that the mirror basically cant be used, so i am driving with the lights switched off. 2. there is no tv tuner fitted, so i cant watch tv. i had assumed it was included and was surprised to find out it isnt. 3. i commute in it, but after turning the engine off it keeps making a loud sound for a while, which makes me feel uneasy.

the car is enjoyable to drive, with plenty of performance for day-to-day use and good comfort, plus enough gadgets to be useful. however an auto-dimming interior mirror as standard would be preferable, and i would happily exchange that for the included reversing assistant. the nearby dealership made the buying process excellent.

i really like the car, but i do miss a few features that i wish were standard, like the passenger mirror dipping when reversing and keyless locking/unlocking. these were things i already had on my previous mini cooper.

so far i am really pleased with the car. what bothers me is that the reverse wing mirror no longer tilts down when reversing, which is a real nuisance. that should be standard and it feels like a step backwards. there is also a clicking sound from the gearbox area when i take my foot off the pedal, which is irritating, though i assume it is the hybrid cutting in.
drives well and is fun, with full safety support kit
design, driving first, comfort, fuel economy, the tech, the colour choices, everything is great.
owned a few of this spec before and have always been pleased with the way they drive and how comfortable they are.

my last vehicle was an x1, but i chose to go down in size and got the 120 m sport. i really like how lively this car feels, very easy to handle and it picks up speed straight away. i also appreciate how it starts easing off the speed when coming up to lower speed limits. there is still plenty of space for passengers.

this is my 5th 1 series and i do think every new version has been an improvement on the last. however, there is one thing bmw should be embarrassed about, and thats asking owners to pay £100 a year just to get automatic changeover between dip and main beam headlights after already shelling out £33000 for the car. a vw polo gives that feature as standard. i await your feedback on this.
love the car, drives great with great tech, really impressive overall

i like this one more than my previous pre-facelift 1 series, mainly because the suspension is improved and the cabin feels more premium. i knock off one point since the fuel economy could be a bit better. otherwise it's a very good car, and i'm happy with both its driving and its looks.

the performance is fantastic, absolutely love how it goes. the styling is great, and those m sport seats along with the interior look beautiful. you can tell everything has been carefully considered and executed as well as it can be. in portimao blue on a sunny day the paint seems so deep you feel like you could dive into it. from the second you open the door it becomes an experience in itself. with this car it really is all about the journey, from the start through the middle to wherever you end up. bmw.
luxurious feel to the drive.
comfortable to drive, nice stylish cabin, and the speakers sound better now.
a delight to drive, the quality shows on its own. the systems are very intuitive and help the driver a lot. overall just brilliant.
really like the new look and the smoother ride vrs the old model.

i dont like it as much as my previous vw vision, its just not as good. centre mirror gets in the way, door and boot both sound tinny when they close, big screen is distracting, and android auto isnt working (being dealt with with the garage).
you do get that feeling of satisfaction from being in a bmw, but too many bits seem worse than local brands, so i really can't tell people to buy it unless they just ignore that fact.
i really hate all the beeping when i go over the limit and the lane assist stuff. the whole computer is too complicated, so even getting apps like spotify or amazon music working is a pain.
it;s a great car, really fun to drive and own, but i;d rate it higher if there weren;t so many irritating software glitches.
great car, very smooth to drive, with lots of innovative features. the app works really well with it.
because the car turned out better than i expected, and because it makes me feel joy every single time i ride in it.

when driving locally, the fuel consumption is worse than you'd expect.
when you come to a halt it doesn't brake smoothly, it almost feels like the car is making a joke.
easy to handle with comfortable ride when driving in the city.
the ride feels very comfrtable.
overall a great car, no problems so far. would just like dual climate control standard, otherwise perfect.

i have been a bmw owner for many years and i am thrilled to have just purchased my new bmw. the premium quality all over this car keeps bmw clearly ahead of other car makers. pure driving feel and loads of driving pleasure. really lives up to being the ultimate driving machine. thank you for building such quality cars, i absolutely love bmw.

i chose this car because i liked the style,
at the time of purchase, the negotiations dragged on and were tied up until late at night.
if i ended up disliking it due to a defect, i was told they would buy it back. i felt pressured by that statement.
from new, the car has constantly had system glitches. even when they say it is repaired, it still is not.
isn't this a basic initial defect? yet it has not been resolved for over 3 months.
the way they respond is slow and all over the place.
who is actually responsible here, the sales staff or the service staff? it's not clear.
a lot of people i know drive bmws, and they have not had any major trouble so far.
i want them to stick to the promise to buy it back.
or i want it to be a car that works properly.

5 door version should really have an opening rear window on the 5th door for transporting animals. there was no handbook, so i could not work out how to separate the driver heated seat from the passenger seat. no glove box on the passenger side, and no cover over the front console where the drink holders are.
fantastic car, i wanted something different from my vw and that's exactly what i got. i really like driving it, it's smooth, very responsive, and has plenty of power when i need it.
it is comfy to drive
had a 1 series before so i knew it would be good, and it has not let me down. for a road car the acceleration is superb.
really happy with both the comfort and the performance.

i used to own a 118 shadow sport edition, and now have the 120m. the 120m is a pleasant car and quite economical, but i do have a few downsides when i compare it to my old one. the boot does not seem as big as before, and the new front design means dirt from the front wheels gets onto the sides of the car very easily, so it needs cleaning all the time. this was not an issue with my previous model.

my new 1 series comes much better equipped than the old one i had, so i am happy about that. i excuse the stiff suspension a bit but much less the bad setting of the door closures, above all the tailgate - you have to close it several times before the locks catch properly! i wonder how long they will last like that?

it is compact and just right for a small family. even though it is an ff model, the handling feels close to an fr, and the 1.5l engine has plenty of power. the typical bmw fun-to-drive character has definitely been carried over.

i'm very happy with the high-speed stability, the fuel economy, the safety features, the heated seats and all that. i changed over from a 116i i purchased in 2014, and the level of luxury now feels so much higher it barely seems like the same one series.
it drives smoothly and the fuel economy seems reasonable. the digital connectivity is very temperamental, the link to devices keeps going on and off. overall it feels a bit basic for what it costs.

i haven't been happy with it because i couldn't get the options i wanted. the salesman told me bmw wouldn't give a price or a delivery date, so i had to go without them. the sport seats don't have any lumbar support and i find them really uncomfortable, with my back starting to ache after only a few miles. when i did the test drive it was in a 2 series, and those seats had lumbar support, were comfortable, and i didn't get any back ache at all. this car also doesn't have any lashing straps, and the salesman said they only come if you add the luggage net option. in the details for that option it clearly says there are 3 additional lashing eyes, so i ordered the luggage net through the salesman and picked it up from the stores, but it turned up with no lashing eyes. i didn't buy it or pay for it online either. later i read an article saying all bmw 1 series 2025 models are supposed to have a lashing eye fitted as standard. on the plus side, the car itself drives really well, with no body roll and very good brakes, and it feels like a driver's car even as an auto. i still think it would be better as a manual.
its a great car to drive, i really love it. i would definitly buy another one and i would recomnend it to my friends.

the car is very comfy and a pleasure to drive, just like the last eight bmws i have had, and even though it is quite a bit smaller than those earlier bmws it still gives the impression of being a bigger car. realy impressed.

great mileage
very cool car

overall i'm satisfied with the car and it stacks up well against the different 3 series models i've owned before. i'm generally very pleased with the tech, but it still feels like it needs some fine tuning. three times the tailgate has suddenly closed by itself while either my wife or i were standing behind the car, and on one occasion the locking catch actually hit me on the head. there have also been occasions where the car has locked with me standing right next to it. another problem is with the warnings: i keep getting a message saying the rear right light cluster has failed, even though it is actually working. my bmw dealer is looking into this and i'm waiting for spare parts - all of this on a new car.
pickup has gotten better and the engine stays pretty quet.
wonderful to drive and really comfy

it is a comfortable place to sit, even if it is not exactly glamorous. driving is mostly good. the sunroof is a let-down though, i would have preferred a larger one. the fact that you push forward for reverse and pull back for drive feels completely crazy to me, i dont understand why anyone would set it up like that. the display isnt great either, everything is tiny, and i only just noticed i was almost out of fuel because it is so hard to see the fuel level. i have almost finished setting up the heating and cooling, but working out where the air actually goes is awkward and there are loads of little controls to fiddle with. i absolutely hate the parking and reversing assist, the car is constantly yelling at me, with margins that seem far too wide. it keeps making warning sounds for no reason i can figure out, and the car has already cut out twice and then would not go either backwards or forwards. i am now about to take it in to be checked.

we were very satisfied with our 128ti, and we are even happier with the 123. it retains all the good traits and performance of the previous car, while giving better fuel economy. the 123 also drives very smoothly, whereas the 128ti sometimes felt a bit aggressive when moving off from a standstill.

such a fantastic car, it gives an amazing driving experience every time. it is fully loaded with equipment and has three driving modes; i have not used the economy setting yet, but will do soon as my daily commute mileage is about to increase a lot. for my needs it is ideal, the interior and exterior build quality feel truly top class, backed up by advanced electronics and security systems. the two year service intervals are a real plus, and the my bmw app is excellent. i have only owned it for a couple of months, it has just finished running in and now it is ready for some proper fun. the drive chain and gearbox are incredibly smooth, and the way it grips the road is superb, always giving me confidence on the twisty country lanes where i live. i do still wish the new regulations did not affect the exhaust sound, as i love the noise from the m series, but sadly my car does not have that same exhaust note.

the car looks great from the outside, the styling has that typical solid bmw look. inside and on the move it has a very solid feel, no rattles, and the automatic gear changes are smooth. i like the personalisation options, and the lower compartment in the boot is really handy for keeping shopping bags and wine boxes stable.
the engine runs very quietly, but when you press the pedal the power that suddenly comes in is really strong and quite impressive.
compact car and very comfortable to travel in
really lovely car, a pleasure to drive, and i'm loving the new mild hybrid economy tooo.

pros - the fresh design is very attractive, the interior quality is excellent and there is some new standard kit, plus the engine with its electric boost is very efficient both in economy and performance. the new infotainment is generally very good, apart from one missing feature. cons - after having 3 118i's i really miss the rotary controller and the shortcut buttons, and finding that standard air recirculation to the rear has been removed is dissapointing. (i even checked with the dealer, thinking it was a mistake, only to be told it is now part of a package) my main disappointment is the media system. when cars lost cd players years ago i copied lots of cds onto a port memory stick and could access them via the media, which is now not possible. however, it is still a very nice car.

i've had a lot of bmws over the years, but this one is easily the most comfortable, from how you sit to the steering wheel and the great all round visibility, plus it's so simple to park. the boot is huge and the space for passengers' legs is really welcome. it practically drives itself and the park assist works brilliantly. i really value the gentle suspension because my spine notices every bump now. the soft touch on the steering wheel and the whole interior look feel much more upmarket than other cars in this segment. honestly i don't think i could have picked a better car, it fits me perfectly. thank you bmw.
very easy to drive, it feels quicker rather than actually faster than the last model.
looks fantastic, drives really nicely, the size is just right, and it has power there when you need it.
really nice car, drives very pleasantly and i like all the new features it comes with.
really lovely looking car, with an interior and tech that are very impressive. feels much nicer all round than the earlier model.
reasonable body size and packed with safe driving support

even though this is an entry-level model, the engine and the functions outside the interior feel comparable to higher-end models. despite being ff, the control sensation is close to fr. the mild hybrid support feels pleasant, and there is almost no turbo lag at the start.

i really like how the car looks and the interior layout. the handling is excellent, but the suspension is very firm and not very comfortable. the touch screen is handy, but also quite complicated to use.
handling feels good and matches driving conditions in japan.
stylish car with smooth driving that makes it enjoyable to use. the ride is comfortable enough that i do not feel tired at all, even on long trips.
customer service at the city centre branch was excellent. the car itself is smooth and also fun to drive.

i would recommend this car to people whose sitting height is low, because it is really a lot of fun to drive.

but for those with a taller sitting height, i would not recommend it and think it should make you stop and reconsider.

the reason is the rearview mirror is oversized, it blocks the left side view and makes the left corner dangerous.

i loved the m2 i had up until last month, but even then the visibility at the left corner was dangerous.
if the rearview mirror design is not improved, i will not purchase this model again.

bmw mirrors are made very large because they are integrated with etc, and on many cars the left visibility is dangerously poor.

bmws drive very well and are great fun, but i will hold off buying another one until the bad visibility from the rearview mirror is fixed.

please, compare the mirrors with other makers and improve the rearview mirror.

i have owned many porsche 911s and caymans before, and i am still waiting for a porsche arriving this month, but their left corner visibility is very good.

in terms of driving enjoyment, bmw is more fun than porsche for me, so the mirror issue is really unfortunate.

i want to keep buying bmw in the future.
best regards.
suspension is quite firm, which might not suit everyone
quality cars, very pleasing to look at and to drive.
strong performance, sharp handling, and a really nice cabin.
high quality car, excellent engine, good miles per gallon and very comfortable overall
engine feels a bit underpowered. the rotating wheel on the center console is gone, so poking at lots of apps on one screen feels awkward and unsafe. also missing any all-wheel drive options.
the computer setup takes ages to figure out and is hard to use while driving without taking your eyes offf the road.

i was ready to give a full 10, as it has been a very smooth, intuitive drive with a great shape and layout and solid fuel economy. however, last week the entire left side of the dashboard suddenly stopped working for no clear reason, so i lost hands free, radio, air con and other essentials, and was anxious about how long i'd be without them and whether it was safe to keep driving, especially with an amber spanner warning showing. i ended up being bounced between the dealer and bmw assist, with neither actually owning or fixing the problem. i was expecting around 3 weeks of having to drive with things not right when, to my surprise and relief, everything started working again the next day. it really played on my worst worries and i'm left wondering when it might fail again. happy to speak with someone at bmw about it.

driving fast and taking it through mountain passes is great fun, but the suspension is quite hard and makes things tough for passengers. since it is really a drivers car, i dont feel it can be suggested to just anyone.
the car gives a lot of driving pleasure. i also feel very secure out on the roads. on top of that, the seller, erik lindholm, provided really good treatment and follow-up.

really like the drive recorder, it caught everything when someone hit me while I was stopped at the lights. when moving off at junctions there's a small delay before the throttle responds, which is a bit worrying. if I leave my partner sitting in the car the alarm still triggers, even though he's got the second key in his pocket. the recessed area in the boot is a great touch as it keeps stuff together.
the suspension is far too hard for everyday use on british roads, it nearly shakes you to bits. i've ended up putting a bag of sand in the boot to try to cure this.
stunning to look at, drives beautifully and is an absolute pleasure to own.
cool interior, runs nicely, and the compact size makes it convenient around the city center.
the whole car feels smooth and it is fun to drive.
infotainment system is really hard to operate, not very intuitive. have to reconnect my phone every single time i get back in the car, even if i just stepped out briefly to put petrol in.
beautiful car with excellent tech and a really strong driving experience.

initial impressions were really positive, but after a few weeks there were technical issues and it had to spend half a day at the service centre in norchester. it was fine again until this month, when a similar fault occurred: the main screen went completely black, making everything it controls unusable. i took it back to the service centre, where they kept it for the day and then overnight to carry out a full reset. they did good work there in norchester, to be fair. hopefully it is now sorted, but the whole situation has definitely taken the shine off the experience of getting and driving my new car.
i absolutely love it, exactly what i wanted. fun to drive, practical, tech works really well. only thing i'm not happy with is the climate control, but i can live with it.

many functions come as standard, and it feels very good to drive.
still, hardly anyone says it, but getting in and out is quite cramped. i think it is meant to appeal to older people whose children have moved out, and that tight access is a drawback. i would like a bit of a rethink on the door shape. also the aircon vent, especially on the driver side, is small and doesn't cool much.
i also want sdv to develop properly, that will be important for keeping it popular going forward.
absolutely love this car!! nice and compact, really simple to park thanks to the parking assist. the speed limit warnings are helpful, and it's very easy to drive, smooth on the road.
solid build, good performance, sharp handling, proper hot hatch vibes, nice looks, efficient and on the whole pretty decent value for the money.

this new f70 feels like a step back from my old f40. there are just too many electronics, no i drive controller anymore, and constant system interventions. the dual clutch gearbox is awful. power and torque are down compared to the previous one. the only real plus point is the suspension setup. overall it's not very good and i'll be looking to swap it out sooner rather than later!!

because the car rides comfortably and the fuel economy is excellent.
however, it bothers me that the lock is quite hard to open.
really comfy small car to drive. love the extra features, especially the heated steering wheel. the bmw app is great and makes things much easier, like checking that the tyre pressures are ok.
nice car, really like the interior. performance and fuel economy are both decent.
really lovely car to drive, a big step up from the 1 series we had around 2020. that one was nice too, but this new hybrid-electric is smooth, comfy and great both in town and on long jorneys.

the car runs really well, but the software side feels unfinished. every time i drive i have to mess with this ridiculously complicated system. i wish the people who made it would actually use it every day themselves.
plus the sales staff barely seem to understand the software, so there are way too many things i still don't know.
ive picked up 5 brand new bmw cars in the last 5 years. m135, 2 450d, 1 230 coupe, 1 123 xdrive and this one now... really not happy with this car at all. i have rejected it. awful transmision.
my car drives easily and comes with lots of features
i find the new bmw 1 series is pretty fairly priced for this type of car. only downside for me is climbing in and out, front or back, the roof line feels a bit too low.
new design is excellent, engine performance much improved, and the new dashboard layout looks smart.
the boot has to be really slammed shut before it closes properly, which is pretty irritating..
very good looking car to begin with. the driving feel is high quality, it seems reliable and it delivers strong performance.

the equipment level is high, with features much like those in top-end models. compared to my old 1 series, the suspension is significantly better and makes it enjoyable to drive. inside the cabin you hardly hear the engine, so you almost forget it is a diesel, yet the power is adequate. overall, very satisfied.
for this vehicle class, the performance is adequate and the design, especially around the monitor area, is a point i would recommend.

for its size, the car is very comfortable. the hydraulic steering on this new model is a major advantage, and the cabin looks modern and high quality. a minor drawback is the upholstery, since your pants tend to catch as you sit down and you do not immediately slide into the seat. overall, it drives smoothly and is very comfortable.

after swapping my old 71 plate 1 series for this one after roughly 3 years, i was really looking forward to an updated model and hassle free, enjoyable driving. instead my new car, now a 120 rather than the 1.8 sport, feels like a much lower spec than what i had before. the seats are now basic, they do have heating but no lumbar support, there is no drivers dimming rear-view mirror, and unlike three cars ago i can no longer move it up and down with a switch. the side mirrors no longer adjust when parking, and it came with no high beam assist, which i then had to pay about £10 to get added. even the hey bmw assistant has been changed from a female voice to a male. i realise some of this can be bought as extras, but i already had these features on my previous cars, so why pay again. the car should include all that and even more, but in my view it just doesn't.

acceleration feels good, and it stays nicely stable when cornering.
recently while driving, the safety device reacted to uneven road, the car suddenly stopped and it almost caused a whip-like jerk.
that is a negative point.
i do like the car overall. however i find the instructions quite unclear, both within the app and on the car's display.
the safety in this car is very good, which i really appreciate. the updated engine feels very responsive and works well, and the fuel consumption is good too.

i've moved from the 1 series f40 to the f70, and it really feels like much more than just a basic facelift. the step up in technology is outstanding, and the handling is still beautifully balanced. little things like the better screen and the improved interior look and feel make a big difference. it's just such a shame that bmw high wycombe treat their customers so appallingly.

i love the styling and how it drives.
there are lots of functions i dont really need, it feels a bit over spec, so i wish it went a bit more analog and the price dropped accordingly so i could downsize.

on the f70, the fuel efficiency has got better.
i dont really feel lcd monitors are good.
it's a cool car but not a 10 out of 10, the way the hybrid links up with the engine is pretty poor, so that is a minus for me.
lovely car to drive, verry comfortable and much easier now that its an automatic.
really happy with the overall quality and finish, but i do not find the settings or software particularly user friendly.

i had to sort out taking the car back to bmw around 3 months after getting it because a rear light was faulty, after an urgent lighting system check recall popped up on my phone, and they replaced the whole light unit. that did not leave a great impression. i just hope that was a one-off bit of bad luck, so it still feels too early to judge it properly.

this is a very good looking car with sharp lines and superb tech and interior. the automatic gearbox shifts seamlessly, with paddle changers on the column available if you want them. it is very quick and handles brilliantly for a three cylinder 1.5 engine. i really like the curved digital screen panel, it is very easy to read. overall a superb, stylish, great looking car.

i moved down from an m135 drive and the power in this one is still absolutely fine and nicely responsive for everyday driving. i much prefer the battery assisted stop/start setup, and the steering has a nice light feel that firms up as you go faster. i am a bit let down that the i-drive knob has gone, as i always thought that system was brilliant when on the move. the new screens look very smart and, once you have them configured, they work well, and the overall fascia design and materials feel excellent. my f70120 m sport drives and handles really well day to day, and i actually like how it looks more than the f40. the front electric seats are really comfy and offer very precise adjustment. i am enjoying the head-up display, its my first time using one. the sat nav reacts quickly and is really helpful when finding your way around unfamiliar routes and towns. i also really like the 'y' style wheels and the red calipers.

solid premium mid-size hatchback, feels well put together, refined and economical. for me the 123 is clearly the standout in the line-up, the 120 comes across as lacking power and the 135 is a touch too strong. bmw uk has cleverly launched a 215ps, economical, nicely specced car that still sits under the luxury car tax limit, and there really is not much else available that matches that formula. also had a good experience with the dealership.
reasonably priced with up-to-date tech, compact and easy to handle in japan, with good everyday usability and safety.
fantastic car overall. the look, the way it handles, how it brakes and the power delivery are all exactly in line with what i expect from a bmw.
the cars themselves are good, just pricey.
overall the car drives really well. in comfort mode it feels pretty much like a luxury car, but once you switch into sport mode the whole character changes and you get a properly powerful ride.
nice mix of performance, kit and price, feels well ballanced.
nice to drive with good fuel efficiency

compared with the 3 series i was in before, the body size itself does not feel much different, but things like the trunk and console box are all smaller now.
the seats have also deteriorated.
the change in the trunk opening and closing adjustment (going from 2 to 3) is way too drastic.
the one improvement is the steering handle, which is lighter and the thickness fits my hand perfectly.
fuel economy is strong and it suits your lifestyle.

i'm happy with how the car looks, but there are a few things i don't like compared with my old bmws (2015 1 series and 2016 2 series). the rear view mirror feels very distorted and kind of zoomed in, so reversing with it is hard as it doesn't show a true view of what's behind. once the emergency brake suddenly activated while i was reversing even though there was absolutely nothing behind me, leaving me stuck in the road holding up traffic. my audio via apple carplay cuts out every time the car is about to do a software update. when i accelerate a bit harder the steering becomes quite jerky and doesn't feel that safe, which never happened on my 2 series m sport that was quick but smooth.

this is my third 1 series and defintely the best so far, even if you still cant beat the three liter engine in the m140. the only negative is the overall price once you add all the extras, that cost is why i only rate it an 8.

i had the earlier 1 series and was so pleased with it that i decided to go for the newest version. the 120 m really impresses me, especially the petrol mild hybrid setup which is giving me 50+ mpg. the changes inside are a big step up too, with the larger dashboard display being particularly good.

i am happy with the car overall but spotted a scratch on the rear seat, and the garage said because i had the car for about 8 weeks they wouldnt repair it. not great on a brand new car, especially as the back seat hasnt even been used.

the car itself is great and i'm very satisfied with it so far. the only annoyance i've come across is the speed limit alerts and having to keep switching them off. i'm also not happy about the reduced boot space due to the mild hybrid battery. apart from that, the car is great, and i have no reason not to strongly recommend bmw overall to both friends and family.
nice fuel efficiency and drives well
really enjoy how it drives and the tech pack with the console screen, but disappointed the boot has to be shut by hand and there's no 12v socket in there.

we would recommend this car as it is reasonably priced, simple to drive and has a full set of driving assistance features so you can feel relaxed behind the wheel. it also makes long-distance trips easy.
well priced car compared with similar models from audi/mercedes benz & vw. very good to drive with an exellent engine and smooth automatc transmission.

driving performance
based on that, i recommended it, and an acquaintance ended up purchasing a 2 series gran coupe at a different store.

the instrument display is inconsistent: sometimes it comes on straight away, other times i have to wait a few minutes for it to start up. i also don't like that the speed limit warning is switched on by default. the seat heating is too intense on the legs and should really concentrate more on the back. the heater in the footwell also feels a bit weak.

i like driving my 120 m sport and it covers all my motoring needs. it is comfy, reliable, quiet and enjoyable. the only irritating thing is there is no paper driver guide, so i have to waste time scrolling through the electronic manual.
for me the ride feels quite comfortable.
easy to drive, you really feel the joy behind the wheel and a good sense of power.
car is verry enjoyable to drive and also economical
fuel economy has got better and it runs steadily.

the car itself is nice but there are some practical downsides. getting just one physical key really feels like cost cutting. the digital keys work inconsistently, and i can only imagine how difficult that must be for anyone who is not confident with digital stuff. and having a survey with only one question seems pretty pointless.
lovely to drive, good servcie, tech seems the best, and its cheap to run and insure
navigation is slow to start

really like the styling. solid performance and the fuel economy numbers are excellent. comfy, particularly for driver and front passenger. the screen functions were confusing until i got used to them. quite unhappy there was no updated driver manual to help enjoy it straight away.
enjoy driving it, feels really stylish.

there is plenty to appreciate but also a couple of niggles. from behind the wheel the suspension feels quite firm, possibly just more noticeable because the cabin is so quiet. the software is very complex and the manual doesn't help much, particularly when i try to use it on my phone; a proper printed booklet might be better. the satnav has sent me down more single track lanes in the past 3 months than i've driven in the last 3 years, so i don't really trust it now. i do, however, like how it integrates with the guidance on the dash.
really nice car, pleasant to drive, uses little fuel but still feels lively and fun. comes across as reliable with a solid quality feel.
moved from a manual bmw to this automatic and it's very easy to drive. good mpg, great looking car, satnav works well and the camera system is excellent.
overall easy ride
love how it drives, happy with the kit and mpg. only downside is having to pay extra for the full digital package, on a car of this quality and price it should really come as part of it

the bmw dealership in riverside was excellent, from the managers through the sales team and reception, everyone we dealt with. very professional and very welcoming. i will certainly go back there and tell others to use them too. the car i ended up with is fantastic and i am really delighted with it, an absolute dream to drive.

after looking at many similar cars, the bmw 120msport came out best for style and colour. it is very high-tech and i am not sure the big touchscreen setup would suit everyone. dealership support has been excellent.

it is enjoyable to drive and very economical, but i do have concerns. getting rid of the idrive controller feels like going backwards, and having almost everything on the touch screen is distracting and not intuitive. i have had 9 bmws and this one is the hardest to configure, even for simple functions.
smart, stlyish, comfortable and straightforward to drive.
great little practical car, very comfortable to drive.
really good comfort and very responisve performance
really happy with it, great car. strong power, feels solidly put together and it drives brilliantly.
the ride is very smooth and comfortable, and you feel very safe because of the way it is built and the driving assistance systems. the dealership were very helpful but not over bearing.
lovely looking car and it drives nicely, but in a few spots it does not quite feel premium, for example the indicator relay noise comes across as cheap.
because the styling is great and the drive feels excellent

the low rating is due to there being no manual option. the automatic gearbox doesnt feel smooth and tends to hop between gears, especially when pulling off, which is quite disappointing. another downside is having to stretch forward to touch the information screen; the old navigation wheel setup was much safer when driving and wanting to adjust any settings.
an awesome car that delivers great comfort along with plenty of power.
the car performed well and the dealer's response was excellent.

the engine runs so smoothly and quietly that it's hard to believe it's only a three-cylinder, yet it still feels strong and capable.
the overall ride comfort is very good.

it is ideal for everyday short legs.
the suspension is reasonably tight, so you can drive briskly around town.
but i would not recommend it for long distances or highway runs.

the car is really enjoyable to drive and nice to sit in. everything works properly and i am pleased with the fuel economy. only small complaint is the auto stop/start feels too sensitive and cuts in too early. otherwise i am very happy.
smooth, solid drive. quick acceleration when needed, and very comforatble overall.
the overall driving quality and the newest driving assistance functions.
very enjoyable car, really well kitted out, excellent engine, and comfort that is very appreciable.
feels really planted on the road, with smooth effortless power. cabin seems high quality and the front seats are excellent.
really great performance when driving at higher speeds.

fantastic car that mixes performance with good economy in one package. love how it looks, it turns heads in its brooklyn grey finish. the cabin is a clear step up from the old 1 series and the controls are straightforward to use and get around. m sport seats are really comfortable.
ideal size for me. strong performance yet still gives 50+ mpg. feels much more refined and like a top tier bmw.

car has been ok overall but it just cut out on my way to work. bmw told me to leave it with them for around 3 weeks and maybe someone could look at it, even though it was only about 4 weeks old. service before delivery was poor. the salesman himself was very good, but i had to keep chasing for any news on when it might actually be ready to pick up.
because of how the compact size works together with the power.

i'm not a fan of touch screens at all, and using them for heater controls is silly, especially when you might need to adjust them while driving. physical, tactile switches are far better. the steering wheel is too thick, not that comfortable, and definitely not as good as on my earlier bmws.

i had a bmw before so i thought i knew what it would be like, but the performance and handling are better than i expected. my only two issues are the tech, which i find not very user friendly, and the ride being a bit harsh, but i can live with both.
smooth, sporty drive and comfy seats. this is the first bmw i have driven and owned, and it really is wonderful.
good car that is enjoyable to drive, but the suspension might not really suit families.
very nice and stable car, comfy and feels safe on the road. i really miss a proper paper handbook though, didnt get one and i kind of hate the digital stuff.
nice ride comfort and a pleasent quiet engine

you can get in and out of tight multi storey parking garages quite easily with this car, and on longer trips the ride feels like it belongs to a class above. also, the maintainence costs are reasonably helpful.
i find the acceleration really strong and the overall ride is comfortable. even though it feels a bit rough and firm at times, i am still satisfied with it.

i'm really delighted with my new bmw, it is a joy to drive. this is my first automatic after years of using manual cars and it definitely makes driving simpler and more comfortable. the auto gear changes are smooth and quiet, and the acceleration feels quick and effortless. i'm also a big fan of the automatic handbrake. the interior was a key factor in choosing this car and it has lived up to what i hoped for. the sat nav screen is easy to read and straightforward to operate, and i've had a lot of fun playing with all the different lighting options. everything feels sturdy and thought-through with the driver in mind, and i'm very pleased with the decision i made. our salesman daniel at rochdale made the whole buying process effortless and kept me well informed throughout.
car is very comfy and lovely to drive. it's our first ever bmw and it wont be our last. would 100 percent recommend it to anyone.

i basically like the car overall, but there are a few serious reservations. the ride is simply too firm even for a performance model, and although adaptive suspension is standard, you can't actually adjust it, which makes its usefulness very debatable. my biggest annoyance, though, is that everyday functions are effectively blocked because i don't own a smartphone and therefore don't use a bmw app. for example, the nearside mirror no longer dips when reversing and auto hold can't be left permanently on. when i first bought the car the salesperson configured these for me, but an ota update wiped those settings and i have no way of getting them back. so i now have a car that cost almost £50k, with features i can't use that were incredibly easy to set up on previous vehicles, which is really disappointing.
good looking car and it drives well too

the car itself is good. the interior has picked up quite a few creaks, which is disappointing. the mybmw app is frustrating, with various stability and functionality problems, like trips vanishing and car updates altering key settings such as handbrake application without clearly showing that this has happend.
i ended up selling the car because the gearbox just wasnt like the bmw gearboxes ive had in any of my earlier bmws, it really was awful.

love this car, really smart, great size and economical. had a 2 series before and i like this 1 series a lot more, would strongly recommend it. driving feel is fantastic, i'm absolutely delighted with my 1 series.
really like the car overall, but since the software was updated there have been a few strange little quirks.
very quiet power when i need it, solid build, still getting used to all the gadgets but overall very happy

the new series one feels well put together but i still favour the older diesel version in several respects. my last car was less chunky, used less fuel and could turn more tightly. on this one the auto-hold is awkward to get to and needlessly complex, and the automatic creep is irritating if you are not using hold. i dont care for all the online extras, just want traffic info, up to date mapping and support in an emergency.
really comfy to drive and the infotainment is excellent.
overall i'm happy with the car, but parts of the interior trim seem below the excellent bmw standard i normally expect.
solid build quality and it drives really well.

as with bmw in general, it is a really good car to drive. the bag hooks in the boot are pretty much useless because they sit too low. maybe it is my age, but i find it disappointing there is no paper handbook, much easier to work with than hunting around online.

vs my old 1 series this one feels lighter overall, including the way it handles.

i also like the tail lights and the 120 badge.
great car, but way too much complicated tech. brake discs went rusty after 3 months and were sorted out by an excellent dealership (hartons burford).

strong engine
solid-feeling body
nice handling
lively performance
really happy with how it performs and how it looks. the seat is less comfortable than i was expecting though, and my phone often fails to connect.

drivetrain problems have been going on since last autumn and the dealer doesn't seem bothered. they had it in once, said a software update sorted it, but it didn't. it's back with them again and they still don't know what's wrong.
fantastic vehicle, really simple to handle with excellent features.

excellent drive, smooth, comfy and a well featured vehicle. fuel efficient and very well engineered too, i absolutley love it! would be good to add a usb-c in the central glove box (since removing it from earlier versions was a bit daft) and maybe a usb-c on the passenger side of the rear view mirror setup so you don't have to run a four metre forward facing camera cable - you could really lead the way here!
fuel use is above what was advertised, and the drivers carpet is already worn after just two months.

the 1 series is a compact car but still gives off a quality feel. even with the small size, the space inside is sufficient. the functions are on par with the higher-end models, including the added tide driving feature, and the diesel has strong power and is fun to drive.

ride comfort
the sophisticated look

it's a really lovely car - rides very smoothly both on local streets and on long motorway journeys. some of the systems can be a bit tricky to work through, but the idrive setup itself is very straightforward and intuitive.

to be frank, after keeping my last car for 7 years i was ready for something different. now i'm disappointed, as it feels a bit too small and too basic for my needs. i've already had trouble with the i drive and was without it for over a month, and now the connected drive is due for renewal. it crashes when going over bumpy but still even roads. i've even talked to ben, my salesman, about swapping it and what choices i have. ben was excellent throughout. it's my own mistake, i'm not pointing the finger at anyone, just not happy with it.

it really is a great car. practical for the whole family, yet quick enough when i want a solo blast. the cabin quality is far ahead of the fast toyotas i have had. fuel economy is excellent, over 40mpg is doable and even with harder driving it stays pretty good. my only gripe, and the reason it did not get 10 stars, is the sound. i would like sport mode to let the exhaust really speak, but it stays too muted. i know eu rules play a part in that, but if i keep it long term i would end up looking at an aftermaket exhaust.

i am really pleased with every aspect of my bmw 120 m sport. the quality of the finish inside and outside is first class, and it is a genuinely lovely car to drive. the automatic gearbox feels very smooth, and the changes are hardly noticeable, especially once you are at higher speeds. the infotainment setup is excellent, and i really enjoy being able to customise the display. when i use the maps, the layout looks great and is easy on the eyes, with all the key info visible at a glance. i especially like the way the next turn or direction step is shown. if i were choosing again, i would go for exactly the same car, which is the strongest recommendation i can give it.

a few of the electronic functions have just quit working on my car, and the worst one is the sat nav. it has dropped back to a very basic navigation system, and apparently i now need to pay extra for the better version.
simple to operate. the car meets our expectations. the only thing to improve would be adding usb sockets in the rear.
it is fun to drive, and even as an entry-level model it has a lot more safety equipment than the regular version. on the flip side, i do feel the price is a bit high for a c-segment car.
really upset that it has been recalled for faulty seat belts, feels like my grandchildren have been put at risk.

i understand bmw is highly rated, especially by motoring journalists, for its impressive technical capability, but i have to say i find this car overly complex and very temperamental. i honestly regret the purchase and wish i had not bought it.

i really like this car. i changed from a 3 series to a new 1 series so it took a while to adapt. looking back, i would have chosen the tech pack. i feel a few things still need tweaking but overall i do love it. the side ambient lights should be dimmable on their own without dimming everything. i have a rattle behind my drivers seat that has been back twice and is booked again for january to hopefully sort it. having to pay for auto full beam and digital plus is annoying, but i still paid as they make the car feel more special. great car that in my view just needs minor adjustments.
fantastic car. we also had the earlier m135i and this one, especially the ride quality, is a big step up.
solid build quailty, looks great and sips fuel

overall the car looks great and the mild hybrid setup performs well. handling is generally very good, though it does hesitate when going over bigger cats eyes on the motorway. the app connection can be awkward and quite often fails entirely. the trip stats feature worked initially but then just stopped on 9th feb. the manual and the youtube guides do not give the right instructions for this new 120 model, so i have been forced to dig around myself to work out how to sort it, which is frustrating. visually, the radio station display is also a letdown.
really nice car, lovely to drive, very comfortable and it handles the roads really well.

been driving bmws for around twenty years and never had any surprise breakdowns. really like the way bmw handles customer service and makes servicing needs clear. this 120 m sport in particular drives excellently, has sporty pickup and on the motorway i'm getting a solid 60+ mpg. absolutely enjoying it.

in the past i've always ended up settling for something on a car, whether it was a gadget i couldn't justify paying for, the paint colour i really wanted, or some tiny detail that still nagged at me every time i got in. this time none of that applies, i get in and just have a really good experience without those little negative thoughts. it's a cracking car and i'm genuinely very happy with it.

overall the car is good, but there are a few problems: 1. there is a lag between pressing the accelerator and the car moving off if you do it while the vehicle is still slowing down, which feels dangerous when pulling out of a junction from a slow roll. 2. the driver seat has an annoying squeak, especially when g force shifts. 3. getting in and out is hard, particularly when the car is parked on any sort of incline.
for a current c-segment model, both the driving performance and the onboard technology feel absolutely top-class.

i'm really happy with the car overall, it drives well and the spec is good. i'm annoyed that my in-car media has run out and bmw now want about £9.50 a month to keep it going, nobody mentioned this when i bought the car. i was also disappointed when i took it in for some work, £480 on the door, and they sprayed the inside with a freshener that smelled awful so the nice new car smell was gone. the wash looked like a child had done it. part of me thinks i should have waited and gone back to harper bmw as the service there was sooo much better and i'd have had a heated steering wheel included. big regret.
i was pleased with the equipment, the fuel efficiency, and how it runs. the follow-up from the sales representative (mr. kato) has been outstanding.

1. the hatchback makes it easy to load luggage while keeping the car compact.
2. it runs on a diesel engine, so fuel costs stay low. it is also a soft hybrid, giving very good fuel efficiency.
3. i am fond of the overall styling.
4. it comes with full safety equipment.

loving my new 120m. i have driven other bmw models and my husband has owned 2 5 series tourers. i do have 3 small complaints with this one: no automatic boot opener as standard, having to turn off lane guidance every single time you start the car, and this safety feature in my view is actually more dangerous than not having it. also the seatbelt is positioned so close to the panel that it scrapes along the column unless you are extremely careful when pulling it and letting it go. bad design.
this is my second one of these and i'd have scored it ten if they hadn't altered the boot, which has ended up with less usable space.

there is a lot about my bmw that i really like. my one issue is that the suspension should be more forgiving for someone my age. when they moved to the f70, the se version disappeared, so mine still comes with sports suspension. i would still recommend the car, but with the warning that the suspension is typical bmw, very sports focused like most of the range. for me it's a shame that bmw no longer really caters for those who want a truly comfortable car for driving on our poor uk roads.

i find the console display for navigation and driver info very good, and all the sensors do help with the occupant's safety. however, with my low mileage i don't really feel like i've had much of a wow factor. taking away the individual button has made the dashboard look cleaner but has also made it harder to alter settings, as you now have to work out which app to go into. some apps like 'spotify' that were on the previous car are now only there if you pay for digital premium, at extra cost. i still need to see if the 'navigation' information has been reduced since the digital premium trial finished. i think losing certain features has pushed the car more into the general mainstream hybrid market. i will definitely check other makers when it is time to swap cars.
i'm mostly happy with it, but riding at low speeds just isnt comfortable.
using the display is awkward, really in all situations

the 120 m sport is a joy to drive and you really feel connected to it on the road. there is a small hesitation when pulling away in normal drive, but switching to s mode fixes that and that is my preferred setting. the cabin is cozy and the view backwards through the side and rear mirrors is very good. the reversing camera makes parking easy. with the pro pack the car's appearance is boosted and the styling stands out even more. the main screen menu and all its options take a bit of time to learn, but it is actually enjoyable to figure it out. i used to have a 320 sport diesel which i was very fond of, and this new 120 m sport feels even more rewarding and fun to drive. the dynamic handling is very accurate and really encourages good driving. i absolutely love it.
really happy with the car itself, it has fantastic features. but getting both my new samsung and the older one to work with android auto was very tricky and unreliable. it seems more stable now.
i really enjoy how it drives, the comfort, and the design of the car. it both feels and looks very upmarket.
doors are awkward to shut and more or less have to be slammed. pairing a phone takes too long and the connection cuts out, so it has to be set up again. only two phones can be stored permanently.
really great car, a lot of fun to drive!

performance is strong and the chassis seems fine to me. steering should be crisper and definitely faster. ride feels like it has settled since i got the car, less bothered by sharp bumps now. overall refinement is good but spoiled by too much tyre noise on poor surfaces. cabin interior is good. hope this is useful.

the frustrating part with this car, and also with my new 5 series, is the driver profile login. it should only need doing once, but every 2 or 3 trips i have to scan the qr code again, which is irritating. i also do not like the lane warning; turning it off once ought to be enough without having to keep deactivating it.
impressive, very refined performance.
this is already my third bmw and i really like it. i feel safe and comfortable when i am driving it, and i also think it looks great.

i have been driving bmws for many years and really like the cars, but now i am very upset that owners, including brand new car owners, have to pay extra for features after buying. it looks like i will need to start paying to keep some really good options because my free ownership period ran out. i can accept this kind of thing when getting a second hand car, but i think new buyers should keep those benefits while they are the first owner. i will certainly examine other makes more closley when we replace our second car later this year, hense the lower score.

its a brilliant car, with an enhanced driving experience. its very much a drivers car but also practical for everyday use and commuting. ive been around bmws since the e30 3 series and i realy love this one.
